summary: The guest book app is built on `desk:apps:book` and tested: it shows the count and names newest-first, saves each typed name to `desk:guestbook` on Enter, ignores an empty Enter, and handles Backspace. I removed the test page `desk:guestbook` and my scratch page, so the page is absent again until someone uses the app. Only rows 3–22 hold names, so with more than 20 guests the oldest ones are not shown.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest book'
task start()
give {typed: '', names: guests(), last: ''}
done
task guests()
set r to []
when exists('desk:guestbook')
set r to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
done
give r
done
task key(s, k)
set t to s.typed
set n to guests()
set l to ''
set m to 0
when k is 'enter'
set m to 1
done
when m is 1
when t is ''
set m to 2
done
when m is 1
set h to 0
when exists('desk:guestbook')
set h to 1
done
when h is 1
add('desk:guestbook', t)
done
when h is 0
write('desk:guestbook', t)
done
set l to t
set t to ''
done
done
when m is 0
set t to edit_text(t, k)
done
give {typed: t, names: n, last: l}
done
task draw(s)
set off to 1
when s.last is ''
set off to 0
done
show(1, 1, (count(s.names) + off) & ' guests')
show(3, 1, s.last)
set i to 0
for each nm in s.names
set i to i + 1
set row to 3 + off + count(s.names) - i
when row < 23
show(row, 1, nm)
done
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
done
